# BlockParty

> BlockParty is a Brooklyn-only party equipment rental company: cornhole, giant Jenga, giant/human-sized beer pong, a slushie or frozen cocktail machine, a portable basketball hoop, and a ball pit — delivered to your block, set up, and picked up after the party, with a confirmation call included in every booking. Packages: Classic $185 / Full $420 / Deluxe $675. À la carte rentals are also available; standalone single-item orders carry a $150 minimum order value. To book, email reserve@blockpartysupply.co and we'll set up your confirmation call.

## Rentals

- [Cornhole Set Rental](https://blockpartysupply.co/rentals/cornhole-rental-brooklyn.html): Regulation 2-board cornhole set with bags, delivered and picked up. $65/day bundled.
- [Giant Jenga Rental](https://blockpartysupply.co/rentals/giant-jenga-rental-brooklyn.html): Oversized stacking-block game, 3–5 feet tall fully built. $65/day bundled.
- [Giant / Human-Sized Beer Pong Rental](https://blockpartysupply.co/rentals/human-beer-pong-rental-brooklyn.html): Oversized buckets and balls, scaled up for a block-party crowd. $75/day bundled.
- [Slushie & Frozen Cocktail Machine Rental](https://blockpartysupply.co/rentals/slushie-machine-rental-brooklyn.html): A real commercial frozen-drink machine, delivered, set up, and picked up after your event. $275/day single-flavor, $375/day double-flavor.
- [Portable Basketball Hoop Rental](https://blockpartysupply.co/rentals/basketball-hoop-rental-brooklyn.html): A real portable hoop system, not a toy-tier set. $85/day bundled.
- [Ball Pit Rental](https://blockpartysupply.co/rentals/ball-pit-rental-brooklyn.html): 6x6 to 8x8 ball pit with balls included, delivered and set up. $325/day.

## Block Party Guides

- [NYC Block Party Permit Guide](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/nyc-block-party-permit-guide.html): How to get an NYC block party permit: eligibility, the E-Apply application, the 60-day deadline, the $25 fee, community board review, and what happens next.
- [Block Party Street Closure Logistics](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/block-party-street-closure-logistics.html): What a closed Brooklyn street involves: barricades, the emergency lane, closure hours, hydrant spray caps, generators, and the rules that keep it clean.
- [Block Party Food, BBQ & Insurance](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/block-party-food-bbq-rules-insurance.html): Can you grill at an NYC block party, when does food need a permit, and does a block party need insurance? What the city's rules say, and what to confirm.
- [Block Party Planning Timeline](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/block-party-planning-timeline.html): A Brooklyn block party timeline that works backwards from the fun: the 60-day permit clock, board follow-up, food notices, and when to book equipment.
- [Block Party Budget Planner](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/block-party-budget-planner.html): What a Brooklyn block party costs: real rental prices from $65/day, the $25 permit fee, the line items to price locally, and where packages beat à la carte.
- [Rain Plan for a Brooklyn Block Party](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/block-party-rain-plan.html): NYC doesn't do rain dates for block parties — build a wet-weather plan instead: the go/no-go call, what moves under cover, and how the rental fits in.
- [What to Rent for Your Crowd Size](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/what-to-rent-for-crowd-size.html): Matching block party rentals to your headcount: packages sized for 10–75 people, à la carte games from $65/day, and when a slushie machine or ball pit fits.
- [When to Book Block Party Rentals](https://blockpartysupply.co/guides/when-to-book-block-party-rentals.html): The deadline math for a block party: the city's 60-day permit clock, our 2-week minimum lead, and why you book equipment the same week you file the permit.

## The Block Party Playbook (blog)

- [The Block Party Playbook](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/): the BlockParty blog — Allie Esslinger's From the Stoop essays on block-party life, plus AI-written trend scans (every AI post is reviewed and approved by Allie before it ships).
- [The party is won in the off-season](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/the-party-is-won-in-the-off-season.html): Block parties are made in the cold months: the January date, the March permit, the gear prepped while the street sits empty. Allie Esslinger on the off-season. From the Stoop — by Allie Esslinger, Founder.
- [When your party outgrows the block-party permit](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/block-party-vs-single-block-festival.html): Selling food or fundraising? When a block party needs a different NYC permit — block party vs. single-block festival vs. street festival, decoded for 2027. AI-written, reviewed and approved by Allie Esslinger.
- [The 2027 Brooklyn block-party calendar: a month-by-month plan](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/2027-brooklyn-block-party-calendar.html): Month-by-month planning for a June 2027 Brooklyn block party: settle the date in January, sound out the board, file by late March, book gear, confirm. AI-written, reviewed and approved by Allie Esslinger.
- [Block party permits: the 60-day rule](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/brooklyn-block-party-permits.html): Brooklyn block-party permits are due 60 days before your event — the CECM/SAPO timeline, the $25 fee, and when to book the fun stuff. AI-written, reviewed and approved by Allie Esslinger.
- [Cornhole brackets that actually work](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/cornhole-tournament-brackets.html): The 8-team, single-elimination cornhole bracket Brooklyn blocks actually finish — timing, rules, board placement, and the bracket to print. AI-written, reviewed and approved by Allie Esslinger.
- [Block party food & frozen-drink trends](https://blockpartysupply.co/blog/frozen-drink-station-trends.html): Frozen-drink stations are becoming the anchor of Brooklyn block-party menus — single- vs double-flavor machines, and food that survives a sidewalk. AI-written, reviewed and approved by Allie Esslinger.
